AF_implies_P.generic_argument: For arbitrary raw m: AF requires a nonempty entry set E ⊆ SF and packageInside. Choose e in E. PackageAt(m,e) includes P(m), hence P(m). This is a direct logical implication under the fixed definitions, not a finite-family inference or a Lean proof.
AF_implies_P.proof_structural_disclosure: P is independently evaluated by map/gluing and assigned clauses; it is not filled from AF.

ambiguities.text: StateViewsResolve/RunReadoutLawsAt are prose, not a new table. Use Substrate.viewScope: all ten state views share the clause cells. Resolve all 160 original coordinates; run readouts are the assigned C6 affine definitions, checked with positive unit ledger/writers across the unbounded closure. No state-varying verdict table is invented.

The G4 positive adapter used positive-only atomicPosAvailable and fixed stage support. Recompute availability from assigned trace/funding/route data; expand vertices by actual event support. Keep the mix_2 audit selectors fixed. Source/target stage support follows the declared single-leg stage-position rule; missing audited event vertices reject.

Run counters are unbounded; factor fixed points use K. Nominal responses have identity environment effects, and are safe across every raw positive outcome. An affine-update/bisimulation argument covers all counts and words; there is no horizon cutoff.

Phase-2 entry requires arrival receiver activation and each complete realized strict route path, supported source history, funded target row and writer availability. Only that executed canonical target policy row contributes successors. Without activation or realization there are no entries; both autonomy versions explicitly gate on this prerequisite independently of withdrawal. Both routes and every resulting entry are checked, with no reset to the pre-probe factor.

The F package is BW, with only target recharge availability changed. Arrival receiver/event/route facts remain historical evidence. Withdrawal removes current response dependencies, not the recorded acquisition history; C7 is not reactivated after withdrawal.

AF→P is structurally implied by the declared PackageAt conjunction, nonempty entry and packageInside. The report gives this mathematical argument and checks every family member; it does not present Python sampling as a kernel proof of the universal theorem.

Greatest sets are unordered subsets. Compute descending pruning to a fixed point and independently enumerate all 1024 subsets for containment; response monotonicity follows because only support containment depends on S.

ceiling: F primary: full preservation of the declared graded package (C4–C7 surrogates), with total target-owned nominal-environment responses and proof-structural lane evidence; AF implies P. O supplementary: narrower operational C8 viability (N3) with predicted logical lane independence. Neither claims P05/T17-I or physical continuation.

AF.packageInside.checks: BW withdrawn resources, recomputed assigned package, all state-view references, run laws; package-filtered greatest fixed point

AF/AO.entry.checks: arrival activation, complete realized strict supported route; only the executed funded row yields entries

AF/AO.greatest.checks: descending fixed point and independent all-subset containment check; support monotonicity argument

AF/AO.response.checks: EVERY invariant state/route context/nominal disturbance, EXIST owned action, EVERY positive successor inside; exact positive conserved ledger and advancement

AF/AO.run.checks: positive conserved unit budget, writer, tick, owner; defined affine readouts and persistent register

AF/AO.support.checks: nonempty exact stochastic row, scaled-integral positive mass and ALL successors inside

AO.viability.checks: same withdrawn inputs, operational C8 greatest set without P/C1-C7 acceptance

L.atomic.checks: actual event support expansion, realized stages, fixed audit vertices, reachability and both intervention projections, strict readout updates

L.bridge.checks: nonempty supported frontier and strict edge; different pasts; representative descent; raw successor, order/tick/progress/record/route/maintenance/owner equations; all four G1c snapshot pairs (afterFirst and endpoint on both routes), eight exact finite-image codecs and occurrence-wise coordinate-map checks

L.endpoint.checks: typed source/target terminal and last realized target exit event, receiver activation, raw class map

L.readout.checks: declared first/last phase selector and target ownership, applied to resulting register

L.route.checks: nonempty raw tuple comparison domain, shared endpoint, activated realized funded step, resulting register and interpreted raw future-readout rule/owner

P.checks: total typed map, value preservation, star cover/dependencies, edge compatibility, completeness, restrictions, coordinate views

P.C1-C8.checks: assignment-scope completeness, row validity, reconstructed C1 audit, C2/C3 raw M and profiles, C4/C5/C7 surrogate checks, C6 and C8

P.C6.future.checks: defined raw-class probabilities/updater, full eight-component observation, finite one-step bisimulation and exact abstract closure with symbolic unbounded count

P.C6.trace.checks: strict events on realized supported paths, unit ticks, funding, writer and owner

wellformed.checks: raw syntax/references/stochastic rows, permitted typed absence distinct from package completeness

predictions.failure_meaning: The assignment/gluing adapter does not reproduce the positive package; no control interpretation from a failing baseline.
The shared corridor/bridge adapter does not reproduce positive lineage.
Full packageInside, total responses or the retained-resource/run-law extension is not supported. This is a genuine failed FULL-autonomy prediction, even if AO passes.
Required C1 input/map completeness did not reject the missing publishedC cell.
Evidence deletion affects lineage as well; report the unanticipated extra side effect.

Failure contradicts the declared packageInside implication AF→P, or one of the two predicates was implemented incorrectly. This expected joint rejection is a consequence, **not an isolation control**.
